cams.name: CAMS (Copernicus) via Open-Meteo
cams.note: Modeled surface concentrations, hourly. 84 of 84 cities returned a series. Used for cities without a current official bulletin row.

cpcb.name: CPCB CAAQMS stations via AQICN/WAQI
cpcb.note: Ground-station data reported by CPCB and state pollution control boards, aggregated by the World Air Quality Index project. WAQI reports its own AQI (US EPA method); stale feeds are excluded from the live count. Current mapped stations: 1 of 9 (≤6h old).

bulletin.name: CPCB Daily National AQI Bulletin
bulletin.note: Official city AQI, 24h average ending 4 PM IST on 2026-11-07. Used as the headline value.
